source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 12 exercise solved (PDF 280-282), every question with an easy model answer and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Human Skeletal and Muscular Systems) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti; har MCQ ka jawab chapter se nikal kar wajah ke saath diya gaya hai. Short sawalon ke jawab mukhtasar aur long sawalon ke poore number wale model jawab hain. Diagram wale sawalon mein diagram banane ka tareeqa aur labels lafzon mein likhe hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which structures are part of the appendicular skeleton?
(Kaun si cheez appendicular skeleton ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Appendicular skeleton girdles aur baazu/taangon ki haddiyan hain; humerus baazu ki haddi hai. Ethmoid (khopri), pasliyan aur lumbar vertebrae axial skeleton ke hisse hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein "Lumber" chhapa hai; sahi lafz lumbar vertebrae hai (kamar ke neeche wale paanch vertebrae).

blocks.prompt:
2. The term muscle fibre or myofibre refers to;
(Muscle fibre ya myofibre se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Muscle ke alag alag cells ko muscle fibres ya myofibres kehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of these extends the entire length of a muscle fibre?
(In mein se kaun si cheez muscle fibre ki poori lambai tak phaili hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har muscle fibre mein 4 se 20 lambe dhaage jaise myofibrils hote hain jo us ki poori lambai mein chalte hain; sarcomere aur filaments myofibril ke andar chhote dohraye jane wale hisse hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Actin filaments are made of proteins;
(Actin filaments kin proteins se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Patle (actin) filaments teen proteins se bante hain: do bal khaye actin strands ka core, us par lipte tropomyosin ke do strands, aur waqfe waqfe se troponin.

blocks.prompt:
5. In a muscle, the Z-line are the proteins for the attachment of the ends of;
((Sahi parhein: the Z-lines are ...) Muscle mein Z-lines kin ke siron ko jorne wale proteins hain?)
blocks.explanation: Patle actin filaments protein discs, yani Z-lines, se jure hote hain; myosin filaments sarcomere ke darmiyan azaad hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "the Z-line are" chhapa hai; sahi "the Z-lines are the proteins" hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Sarcomere is a part between;
(Sarcomere kin do cheezon ke darmiyan ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Myofibril ka do Z-lines ke darmiyan wala hissa sarcomere hai, jo muscle contraction ki sab se chhoti unit hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which part of muscle fibre releases calcium ions which trigger contraction?
(Muscle fibre ka kaun sa hissa calcium ions chhorta hai jo contraction shuru karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nerve ka signal sarcolemma aur T-tubules se sarcoplasmic reticulum tak jata hai, jo calcium ions chhorta hai; calcium troponin se jur kar contraction shuru karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Which statement is correct to describe sliding filament model of muscle contraction?
(Sliding filament model ko kaun sa bayan sahi bayan karta hai?)

options.text: Myosin sarcomere ko kheenchta hai aur actin chhota hota hai
Myosin actin ko kheenchta hai aur sarcomere chhota hota hai
Actin myosin ko kheenchta hai aur sarcomere chhota hota hai
Actin sarcomere ko kheenchta hai aur myosin chhota hota hai

blocks.explanation: Myosin ke heads actin se jur kar cross-bridges banate hain aur darmiyan ki taraf jhuk kar actin filaments ko kheenchte hain (power stroke); sarcomere chhota hota hai lekin filaments khud chhote nahi hote.

blocks.prompt:
9. When a muscle fibre shortens, which of the following also shortens?
(Jab muscle fibre chhota hota hai to kaun si cheez bhi chhoti hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Contraction mein patle filaments mote filaments par phisalte hain; Z-lines qareeb aati hain, is liye har sarcomere chhota hota hai, jab ke actin aur myosin filaments ki lambai wohi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. Which statement correctly describes an event of muscle contraction?
(Muscle contraction ke kis waqia ka bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: Myosin heads troponin se jurte hain
ATP actin ki binding site se jurta hai
ATP myosin head ko actin se alag karne mein istemal hota hai
Troponin binding sites ko dhakta hai

blocks.explanation: Power stroke ke baad naya ATP myosin head se jurta hai aur head actin se alag ho jata hai; ATP ke tootne se head wapas apni jagah aata hai. Myosin heads actin se jurte hain (troponin se nahi), aur binding sites tropomyosin dhakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
11. Tendons connect bone and;
(Tendons haddi ko kis se jorte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tendons mazboot connective tissue hain jo skeletal muscle ke siron par ban kar muscle ko haddi se jorte hain; ligaments haddi ko haddi se jorte hain.

blocks.prompt:
12. What is true about antagonistic pair of muscles?
(Antagonistic muscles ke jore ke baare mein kya sahi hai?)

options.text: Aik muscle zakhmi ho to doosra backup deta hai
Aik muscle dhakelta hai, doosra kheenchta hai
Muscles ulti (opposing) harkatein kar pate hain
Contraction ki taaqat dugni ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Muscles jore mein kaam karte hain jo ulti harkatein karte hain: flexor jor ko morta aur extensor seedha karta hai. Muscles sirf kheench sakte hain, dhakel nahi sakte.

blocks.prompt:
1. Name three types of cells associated with bone and write their functions.
Haddi se mutaliq teen qisam ke cells ke naam aur un ke kaam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Osteoblasts: haddi banane wale cells; matrix (bunyaadi maadda) chhorte hain.
2. Osteocytes: lacunae mein pakke (mature) bone cells; haddi ko sehatmand rakhte aur haddi se blood mein calcium ka ikhraaj control karte hain.
3. Osteoclasts: macrophages se bante hain; haddi ko torte hain (resorption) aur calcium aur phosphate blood mein chhorte hain; growth aur marammat ke liye zaroori.

blocks.prompt:
2. Name the bones of cranium.
Cranium (khopri ka dimaghi dabba) ki haddiyon ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Aath cranial haddiyan:
Jore wali: 2 parietal aur 2 temporal.
Akeli: frontal, occipital, ethmoid aur sphenoid.

blocks.prompt:
3. Enlist the bones in the five groups of vertebrae.
Vertebrae ke paanch groups ki haddiyan likhein.
blocks.explanation:
33 vertebrae:
1. Cervical: 7 (gardan; pehla atlas, doosra axis).
2. Thoracic: 12 (seena; pasliyan uthate hain).
3. Lumbar: 5 (pait/kamar).
4. Sacral: 5 (jur kar sacrum).
5. Coccygeal: 4 (jur kar coccyx).

blocks.prompt:
4. What bones make the rib cage?
Rib cage (pasliyon ka pinjra) kin haddiyon se banta hai?
blocks.explanation:
12 jore (24) pasliyan aur sternum (seene ki haddi); peeche pasliyan 12 thoracic vertebrae se juri hoti hain.
Pasli 1-7 (true) apni costal cartilage se sternum se, 8-10 (false) mushtarka cartilage se, aur 11-12 (floating) sternum tak nahi pohanchtin.

blocks.prompt:
5. Name the bones of pectoral girdle and pelvic girdle.
Pectoral girdle aur pelvic girdle ki haddiyon ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Pectoral girdle: aik jora clavicles (hasli ki haddi) aur aik jora scapulae (kandhe ki haddi).
Pelvic girdle: do hip bones; har aik teen juri haddiyon se bani hai: ilium (kitab mein "ileum" chhapa hai), ischium aur pubis, jo acetabulum (pyala) banati hain. Aage dono pubic symphysis par milti hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Name the bones of forelimbs and hindlimbs.
Forelimbs (baazu) aur hindlimbs (taang) ki haddiyon ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Forelimb (30 haddiyan): 1 humerus, 1 radius, 1 ulna, 8 carpals (kitab mein "carpels"), 5 metacarpals, 14 phalanges.
Hindlimb (30 haddiyan): 1 femur, 1 patella (ghutne ki chapni), 1 tibia, 1 fibula, 7 tarsals, 5 metatarsals, 14 phalanges.

blocks.prompt:
7. What is fibrous joint? Give examples.
Fibrous joint kya hai? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Fibrous (na hilne wala) joint woh hai jis mein haddiyan seedha fibrous connective tissue (zyada tar collagen) se juri hon; koi harkat nahi hoti.
Misalein: khopri ki haddiyon ke sutures; tibia aur fibula ka jor; daanton aur jabre ke khanon ka jor.

blocks.prompt:
8. Name the steps involved in bone repair.
Haddi ki marammat (bone repair) ke steps ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se bahar; chapter sirf itna kehta hai ke marammat mein osteoclasts aur osteoblasts kaam karte hain.)
1. Toot ki jagah haematoma (khoon ka lothra) banta hai.
2. Soft (fibrocartilage wala) callus bante hue toote siron ko jorta hai.
3. Hard (haddi wala) callus: osteoblasts cartilage ko nayi haddi se badalte hain.
4. Remodelling: osteoclasts zaid haddi hatate hain aur haddi apni shakal mein aa jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. What skeletal structures are affected from the osteoarthritis?
(Sahi parhein: affected by osteoarthritis) Osteoarthritis se kaun se skeletal hisse mutasir hote hain?
blocks.explanation:
Osteoarthritis joints mein haddiyon ke siron par articular cartilage ko mutasir karta hai jo aahista aahista naram ho kar toot jati hai.
Zyada mutasir: ghutne, kulhe (hip) aur vertebrae ke darmiyan ke joints.

blocks.prompt:
10. List the major parts of skeletal muscle fibre.
Skeletal muscle fibre ke bare hisse likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Sarcolemma (plasma membrane) aur us ki T-tubules.
2. Sarcoplasm (cytoplasm) jis mein kai nuclei hote hain.
3. Sarcoplasmic reticulum (Ca²⁺ jama karta aur chhorta hai).
4. Myofibrils (4-20), jo mote myosin aur patle actin filaments se bante hain aur sarcomeres (Z-lines, A-band, I-band, H-zone) mein tarteeb diye hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
11. What do you mean by I-band, A-band and H-zone?
I-band, A-band aur H-zone se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation:
I-band: halki band jahan sirf patle (actin) filaments hain, Z-line ke dono taraf.
A-band: gehri band; mote (myosin) filaments ki poori lambai, jahan actin un par charha hota hai woh bhi shaamil.
H-zone: A-band ka darmiyani halka hissa jahan sirf myosin hai (overlap nahi); contraction mein tang ya khatam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
12. Describe the antagonistic arrangement of skeletal muscles.
Skeletal muscles ki antagonistic tarteeb bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Jor par haddi ko do taraf hilane ke liye muscles jore mein kaam karte hain jo ulti harkatein karte hain (antagonistic tarteeb). Flexor contract ho kar jor morta hai aur extensor dheela hota hai; extensor contract ho kar seedha karta hai aur flexor dheela hota hai.
Misal: ghutne par hamstrings (flexor) aur quadriceps (extensor).

blocks.prompt:
13. Ligaments are elastic while tendons are hard. Justify.
Ligaments lachakdar (elastic) hain jab ke tendons sakht hain. Saabit karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ligaments jor par haddi ko haddi se jorte hain; in mein elastic fibres hote hain aur yeh thora khinchte hain, is liye jor hil sakta hai aur haddiyan bhi juri rehti hain.
Tendons muscle ko haddi se jorte hain; yeh ghane, mazboot collagen ke bane hote hain jo mushkil se khinchte hain, is liye muscle ka poora zor haddi tak pohanchta hai. (Kuch hissa chapter se bahar.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tendon ko mazboot rassi samjhein (khinchti nahi, poora zor aage deti hai) aur ligament ko rubber wali belt (thori khinchti hai, jor ko hilne deti hai lekin haddiyan apni jagah rakhti hai).

blocks.prompt:
14. Draw a diagram of sarcomere and label its parts.
Sarcomere ki diagram bana kar us ke hisson ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Banane ka tareeqa (leta hua sarcomere):
1. Dono siron par do khari lakeerein: Z-lines. In ke darmiyan aik sarcomere hai.
2. Har Z-line se darmiyan ki taraf patli leti lakeerein: actin (patle) filaments.
3. Beech mein moti lakeerein jo actin ke andar wale siron par charhi hon: myosin (mote) filaments, chhote heads (cross-bridges) actin ki taraf.
4. Beech mein myosin ke darmiyan khari lakeer: M-line.
Labels: Z-line, sarcomere (Z se Z), actin filament, myosin filament, A-band (myosin ki poori lambai), I-band (sirf actin, Z-lines ke paas), H-zone (beech, sirf myosin), M-line.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the structure of bone.
Haddi ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Haddi connective tissue hai jo calcium aur khaas bone cells se mazboot hoti hai. Yeh geeli aur zinda tissue hai.
1. Periosteum: haddi ki satah par sakht jhilli; collagen fibres ise neeche ki haddi se bandhe rakhte hain.
2. Compact bone: periosteum ke neeche moti, sakht tah; haddi ka zyada hissa. Is ki units Haversian systems hain, har aik mein:
   - Lamellae: mineral wale matrix ki gol tahein jin mein collagen fibres (lachakdar) aur calcium phosphate ke sui jaise crystals (sakht) hote hain; is liye haddi mazboot bhi aur lachakdar bhi.
   - Lacunae aur osteocytes: lamellae ke darmiyan chhoti jagahein jin mein pakke bone cells (osteocytes) hain, jo canaliculi (nanhi nalion) se aapas mein aur Haversian canal se jure hain.
   - Haversian canal: darmiyani nali jis mein blood vessels, nerves aur lymph vessels hain.
   - Aari (perpendicular) nalian Haversian canals ko aapas mein aur periosteum se jorti hain.
3. Spongy bone: compact bone ke neeche; haddi ke kaanton ki jaali, halki aur mazboot.
4. Bone marrow: red marrow (spongy bone, lambi haddiyon ke sire, pasliyan, vertebrae, sternum, pelvis) RBCs, WBCs aur platelets banata hai; yellow marrow (lambi haddi ki shaft mein) zyada tar charbi hai, energy ka zakheera, aur zyada khoon behne par red ban sakta hai.
5. Bone cells: osteoblasts (haddi banate), osteocytes (sambhalte, calcium control), osteoclasts (haddi torte).
6. Lambi haddi ke hisse: chaure sire epiphysis, darmiyani hissa diaphysis (shaft).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Compact bone ko imaarat ki mazboot bahari deewar aur spongy bone ko andar ke halke magar mazboot jaal (truss) samjhein: wazan kam, taaqat zyada.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the structure of three types of cartilage.
Cartilage ki teen qisamon ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cartilage ki aam banawat:
1. Perichondrium: cartilage ke gird connective tissue ki tah, jis mein blood vessels, lymphatics aur nerves hain jo cartilage ko ghiza dete hain.
2. Matrix: collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre fibres; mazbooti, lachak aur dabao sehne ki taaqat deta hai. Is mein blood vessels nahi, is liye cells ko diffusion se ghiza milti hai aur cartilage der se theek hota hai.
3. Chondrocytes: matrix ki chhoti jagahon (lacunae) mein cartilage cells; matrix banate aur sambhalte hain.
Teen qisamein:
1. Hyaline cartilage: sab se aam; chikna, sheeshe jaisa matrix jis mein bareek collagen fibres (fibres ki tafseel chapter se bahar). Naak, trachea aur joints mein haddiyon ke siron (articular cartilage) par.
2. Fibrocartilage: matrix mein collagen ke mote guchhe (chapter se bahar), is liye sab se mazboot; zyada dabao aur khinchao wali jagahon par: intervertebral discs aur pubic symphysis.
3. Elastic cartilage: matrix mein bohat se elastic fibres (chapter se bahar), is liye lachakdar aur wapas apni shakal mein aata hai; bahar ke kaan aur epiglottis mein.

blocks.prompt:
3. Write the cause and symptoms of joint dislocation, spondylosis, and sciatica.
Joint dislocation, spondylosis aur sciatica ki wajah aur alamaat likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Joint dislocation (jor ki haddiyon ka apni jagah se nikal jana):
Wajah: achanak chot ya hadsa; rheumatoid arthritis bhi. Shadeed dislocation muscles, ligaments aur tendons ko phaar sakti hai.
Alamaat: soojan, shadeed dard, aur jor ka na hil pana.
(Kitab ki islah: jor doctor wapas bithata hai, physiotherapist nahi; khinche ligaments ke liye surgery bhi ho sakti hai.)
Spondylosis (reedh ki haddi ke vertebrae, discs, ligaments ya cartilage ka ghisna):
Wajah: umar ke saath discs ka qudrati ghisna (sab se aam), moroosi factors, chot, lambe arse tak ghalat posture aur motapa. Discs patli ho kar jur jati hain aur haddi ke ubhaar bante hain jo nerves ya spinal cord ko dabate hain; zyada tar gardan (cervical) aur kamar (lumbar) mein.
Alamaat: kamar ya gardan mein dard, akraao aur harkat ka kam hona.
Sciatica (sciatic nerve ka dabna ya chhirna; yeh nerve kamar se koolhon ke raaste har taang mein jati hai):
Wajah: aksar slipped ya ubhri disc nerve ko dabati hai; chot, infection, soojan aur spondylosis bhi.
Alamaat: kamar, koolhon, taangon ya pairon mein dard; taangon ya pairon mein jhunjhunahat ya sunn pan; taangein hilane mein kamzori ya mushkil.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the types of arthritis, with their causes, symptoms and treatments.
Arthritis ki qisamein, un ki wajuhaat, alamaat aur ilaaj ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Arthritis joints ki mukhtalif soojan wali bimariyon ka naam hai. Sab ki mushtarka alamaat: jor mein dard aur akraao, saath laali, garmi aur soojan.
1. Osteoarthritis (sab se aam):
Wajah: joints mein haddiyon ke siron ki articular cartilage aahista aahista naram ho kar toot jati hai (umar ke saath ghisna).
Joints: ghutne, kulhe aur reedh ke joints.
2. Rheumatoid arthritis:
Wajah: autoimmune bimari (jism ka defence apne hi tissue par hamla kare) jis mein synovial membrane soojh jati hai.
Joints: zyada tar kalaiyan aur haath; dislocation bhi kar sakti hai.
3. Gouty arthritis (gout):
Wajah: blood mein uric acid barh kar joints mein crystals banata hai aur soojan karta hai.
Joints: zyada tar paon ka angootha; ghutne, kalaiyan aur ungliyan bhi.
Ilaaj (chapter se bahar; chapter arthritis ka ilaaj nahi deta):
- Dard aur soojan kam karne wali dawaein; aaram, garam ya thandi sikai aur physiotherapy.
- Wazan control aur halki warzish (osteoarthritis); immune system ko dheema karne wali dawaein (rheumatoid); laal gosht kam, paani zyada aur uric acid kam karne wali dawa (gout).
- Bohat kharab jor ke liye joint replacement (poora ya kuch hissa) ya chondrocyte implantation (chapter ke joint transplantation box mein).

blocks.prompt:
5. Describe the three types of muscles.
Muscles ki teen qisamein bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Muscle woh tissue hai jo mil jul kar contract ho kar jism ke hisson ya poore jism ko hilata hai. Teen qisamein hain:
1. Skeletal muscle:
- Jagah/kaam: tendons se haddiyon se jure; baazu, dhar aur chehra hilate hain (skeleton ko harkat).
- Fibres: lambe, beelan numa (cylindrical), kai nuclei wale, baqaida dhaariyan (striations).
- Control: voluntary (apni marzi se).
2. Smooth muscle:
- Jagah/kaam: maida, aantein, blood vessels aur doosre andaruni aazaa ki deewarein; khokhle aazaa mein cheezon ko aage dhakelte hain.
- Fibres: takle (spindle) jaise, aik nucleus, dhaariyan nahi, connective tissue se ghire.
- Control: involuntary (apni marzi se nahi).
3. Cardiac muscle:
- Jagah/kaam: sirf dil ki deewaron mein; blood pump karte hain.
- Fibres: shakhon wale, dhaari daar (be-qaida dhaariyan), har cell mein aam tor par aik darmiyani nucleus.
- Control: involuntary.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain the ultrastructure of skeletal muscle.
Skeletal muscle ki ultrastructure (bareek banawat) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tarteeb: skeletal muscle muscle fibres (cells) ke guchhon se banta hai jo collagen aur connective tissue mein band hote hain; yahi siron par tendons banata hai. Har fibre mein myofibrils, aur har myofibril mein myofilaments (myosin aur actin).
Muscle fibre:
1. Lamba, beelan numa, kai nuclei wala cell jo sarcolemma (plasma membrane) mein band hai.
2. Is ka cytoplasm sarcoplasm hai jis mein sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) hai jo Ca²⁺ jama rakhta hai.
3. Sarcolemma andar dhans kar transverse (T) tubules banati hai jo SR ke siron tak pohanchti hain.
4. Is mein 4-20 dhaage jaise myofibrils hote hain.
Myofibril aur sarcomere:
1. Myosin ke mote filaments gehri A-bands aur actin ke patle filaments halki I-bands banate hain; yahi dhaariyan hain.
2. Patle filaments protein discs, yani Z-lines, se jure hain. Do Z-lines ke darmiyan sarcomere hai, contraction ki sab se chhoti unit.
3. Sarcomere mein actin har Z-line se darmiyan ki taraf aata aur myosin par charhta hai; A-band ka darmiyani halka hissa jahan overlap nahi H-band (zone) hai; us ke beech gehri M-line mote filaments ko sambhalti hai.
Myofilaments:
1. Mota filament (taqreeban 16 nm): bohat se myosin molecules, har aik do lipti polypeptide chains jo gol head par khatam hoti hain; head actin se jurta hai (cross-bridges).
2. Patla filament (7-8 nm): actin ke do bal khaye strands; tropomyosin ke do strands jo ise sakht karte aur aaram mein myosin binding sites dhakte hain; troponin (teen polypeptides: actin, tropomyosin aur calcium se jurne wale).

blocks.prompt:
7. Write a detailed note on the sliding filament model of muscle contraction.
Muscle contraction ke sliding filament model par tafseeli note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Sliding filament model ke mutabiq muscle tab contract hota hai jab us ke patle (actin) filaments mote (myosin) filaments par phisal kar zyada overlap karte hain; filaments khud chhote nahi hote.
1. Aaram wala sarcomere: sarcomeres normal lambai par. Myosin heads actin se nahi jur sakte kyun ke tropomyosin binding sites ko dhake hue hai; troponin tropomyosin se jura hai. Har myosin head pehle hi ATP ko ADP aur Pi mein tor chuka hai (tayyar halat).
2. Nerve signal ka aana: motor neuron synapse par acetylcholine chhorta hai; signal sarcolemma aur T-tubules se sarcoplasmic reticulum tak jata hai jo Ca²⁺ chhorta hai. Ca²⁺ troponin se jurta hai jo tropomyosin ko actin ki binding sites se hata deta hai.
3. Cross-bridges aur power stroke: myosin heads khuli sites se jur kar cross-bridges banate hain. ADP aur Pi chhor kar shakal badalte aur sarcomere ke darmiyan ki taraf jhukte hain, actin ko saath kheenchte hain (power stroke). Z-lines qareeb aati hain, sarcomere chhota, I-band tang aur H-zone khatam; A-bands ki lambai wohi rehti hai magar qareeb aati hain. Yeh sab sarcomeres mein aik saath hota hai, is liye poora muscle contract hota hai.
4. Alag hona: naya ATP har myosin head se jurta hai aur head actin se alag ho jata hai. ATP ke ADP aur Pi mein tootne se head phir tayyar hota hai; jab tak Ca²⁺ aur ATP hain, cycle chalta rehta hai.
Relaxation (chapter ke steps se bahar): signal rukne par Ca²⁺ wapas SR mein chala jata hai, tropomyosin phir sites dhak leta hai aur muscle dheela ho jata hai.
Note: maut ke baad ATP nahi banta, is liye cross-bridges alag nahi hote: rigor mortis (laash ka akarna).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rassa kashi (tug of war) socheiye: myosin heads haathon ki tarah actin ki rassi pakarte, kheenchte, chhorte aur aage se phir pakarte hain. Rassi chhoti nahi hoti, bas andar khinchti hai; isi tarah sarcomere chhota hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Explain the action of antagonistic muscles in the movement of knee joint.
Ghutne ke jor ki harkat mein antagonistic muscles ka amal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Muscles sirf kheench sakte hain, is liye jor ko do taraf hilane ke liye antagonistic jore mein kaam karte hain: aik (flexor) contract ho to doosra (extensor) dheela, aur ulta. Har muscle ka origin na hilne wali haddi par aur insertion hilne wali haddi par hota hai.
Ghutne ka jor femur (raan ki haddi) aur tibia aur fibula (pindli ki haddiyon) ke darmiyan hai. Yeh hinge (qabze jaisa) joint hai.
1. Flexion (taang morna): hamstrings karte hain, raan ke peeche teen muscles ka group. Origin: pelvic girdle aur femur ka oopar ka hissa. Insertion: tibia aur fibula ke oopar ke hisse. Hamstrings contract hon to taang murti hai aur quadriceps dheele hote hain.
2. Extension (taang seedhi karna): quadriceps karte hain, raan ke aage chaar muscles ka group. Origin: ilium (pelvic girdle) aur femur. Insertion: patella (ghutne ki chapni) aur tibia. Quadriceps contract hon to taang seedhi hoti hai aur hamstrings dheele.
Yun hamstrings ghutne ke flexor aur quadriceps extensor hain; in ka baari baari sukarna aur dheela hona chalna, daurna aur kick karna mumkin banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Draw a diagram of sarcomere and label its parts.
Sarcomere ki diagram bana kar us ke hisson ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Sarcomere ki labelled diagram (leti hui banayein), qadam ba qadam:
1. Baen aur daen siron par do khari lakeerein khenchein, har aik par "Z-line" likhein. In ke darmiyan dono taraf teer wali lakeer par "Sarcomere" likhein.
2. Har Z-line se darmiyan ki taraf kai patli mutawazi (parallel) leti lakeerein jo beech tak na pohanchein: "Actin (patla filament)".
3. Beech mein moti mutawazi lakeerein jo actin lakeeron ke darmiyan hon aur un ke andar wale siron par charhi hon; in se actin ki taraf chhote ubhaar banayein: "Myosin (mota filament)" aur "Cross-bridges (myosin heads)".
4. Bilkul beech mein myosin ke darmiyan khari lakeer: "M-line".
5. Brackets se bands dikhayein:
   - "A-band" (gehri): myosin filaments ki poori lambai.
   - "H-zone": A-band ka darmiyani hissa jahan sirf myosin hai (actin nahi).
   - "I-band" (halki): Z-line ke dono taraf sirf actin wala hissa (sarcomere ke har sire par aadha I-band).
6. (Zaroorat ho to) neeche aik contract shuda sarcomere: Z-lines qareeb, I-band aur H-zone tang, A-band ki lambai wohi.
Labels: Z-line, sarcomere, actin filament, myosin filament, cross-bridges, M-line, A-band, I-band, H-zone.

blocks.prompt:
10. Describe causes and symptoms of muscle fatigue, cramps and tetany.
Muscle fatigue, cramps aur tetany ki wajuhaat aur alamaat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Muscle fatigue (lambi ya sakht mehnat, ya bimari ke baad muscle ki karkardagi ka gir jana):
Wajuhaat:
1. ATP khatam ho jata hai, muscle contract nahi kar pata.
2. Fuzlaat (lactate, hydrogen ions, reactive oxygen) jama ho jate hain.
3. Baar baar kaam karne wale fibres calcium ions ko theek se nahi sambhal pate.
4. Sakht warzish se fibres ko chhota nuqsan aur soojan.
Alamaat: dard, taaqat ka kam hona, jaldi thak jana. Aaram se behtar hota hai; shadeed ho to doctor.
Muscle cramps (achanak, be-ikhtiyar, aksar dardnaak akarn jo chand second se kai minute rehti hai, zyada tar taangon aur pairon mein):
Wajuhaat: paani ki kami, namkiyat ka adam tawazun, muscle ka zyada istemal ya chot, kuch dawaein (maslan diuretics), aur diabetes, liver ki bimari, nerve ka nuqsan.
Alamaat: muscle ka achanak dardnaak akarna. Aaram: halka khinchna aur malish, garam ya thandi sikai, dard ki dawa.
Tetany (muscle tone zyada aur nerves bohat tez hone se be-ikhtiyar akarn):
Wajuhaat: zyada tar hypocalcaemia (blood mein calcium kam) jo vitamin D ki kami, gurdon ki nakami ya thyroid ki kharabi se hoti hai; magnesium ki kami jaisi doosri namkiyat ki kharabi bhi.
Alamaat: haathon, pairon, chehre ya larynx mein akarn. Ilaaj wajah ke mutabiq: calcium ya magnesium supplements ya drip (intravenous fluids).

blocks.prompt:
11. Justify how the main functions of the skeleton are to act as a system of rods and levers.
Saabit karein ke skeleton ka bara kaam rods aur levers ke system ki tarah kaam karna hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Rods (sariya): haddiyan sakht rods hain (calcium phosphate crystals aur collagen ki wajah se mazboot aur lachakdar) jo jism ko dhancha aur sahara deti aur andaruni aazaa ki hifazat karti hain.
2. Fulcrum (dhuri): joints fulcrum hain jin ke gird haddiyan ghoomti hain, is se harkat hoti hai.
3. Effort (zor): tendons se haddiyon se jure skeletal muscles kheench kar zor lagate hain.
4. Load (bojh): jo wazan ya rukawat hilai jaye (jism ka hissa ya cheez) woh load hai.
Misal: haath mein wazan uthana: kalai aur kohni ke darmiyan ki haddiyan (radius aur ulna) lever hain, kohni fulcrum, biceps effort aur wazan load. (Kitab kehti hai biceps lever hai; sahi yeh hai ke forearm lever hai aur biceps zor deta hai.)
Muscles sirf kheenchte hain, is liye antagonistic jore (biceps/triceps, hamstrings/quadriceps) har lever ko dono taraf chalate hain. Yun sahara, hifazat aur harkat sab skeleton ke rods aur levers ki tarah kaam karne se hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: See-saw (jhoola) socheiye: beech ka pivot fulcrum hai, aik taraf bacha (load), doosri taraf aap zor (effort) lagate hain. Kohni pivot, forearm takhta, biceps zor aur haath ka wazan load.

blocks.prompt:
12. Justify why do the muscles pull but do not push.
Saabit karein ke muscles kheenchte kyun hain, dhakelte kyun nahi.
blocks.explanation:
1. Muscle fibres sirf aik kaam khud kar sakte hain: sukarna aur chhota hona. Myosin heads actin ko kheenchte hain to sarcomeres chhote hote hain; khud lamba hone ka koi nizaam nahi.
2. Muscle tendons se do haddiyon se jura hai (origin na hilne wali haddi par, insertion hilne wali par). Contract ho kar insertion ko origin ki taraf kheenchta hai aur haddi hilti hai.
3. Muscle dheela ho to haddi ko wapas dhakel nahi sakta; naram ho jata hai aur muqabil (antagonistic) muscle ke khinchao ya gravity se wapas lamba hota hai.
4. Isi liye muscles antagonistic jore mein hain: maslan ghutne par hamstrings kheench kar morte aur quadriceps kheench kar seedha karte hain.
(Kitab ka box kehta hai ke muscles aam tor par sirf aik sire par haddi se jure hote hain; asal mein skeletal muscles dono siron par jure hote hain, jaisa kitab khud origin aur insertion mein kehti hai. Asal wajah yeh hai ke fibres sirf khud chhote ho sakte hain.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rassi se cheez kheench sakte hain, dhakel nahi sakte. Muscle bhi rassi ki tarah sirf kheenchta hai; wapas lane ke liye doosri taraf doosri rassi (antagonistic muscle) chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why is calcium essential for both the structural integrity of bones and the process of muscle contraction?
Calcium haddiyon ki mazbooti aur muscle contraction dono ke liye zaroori kyun hai?
blocks.explanation:
Haddiyan: lamellae ke matrix mein calcium phosphate ke sui jaise crystals hote hain jo haddi ko sakht aur mazboot banate hain; collagen ke saath mazboot bhi aur lachakdar bhi. Calcium (aur use jazb karane wale vitamin D) ki kami se haddiyan kamzor (osteoporosis).
Muscle: sarcoplasmic reticulum se nikla Ca²⁺ troponin se jurta hai jo tropomyosin ko actin ki binding sites se hatata hai; tab hi cross-bridges bante aur muscle contract hota hai. Blood mein calcium kam (hypocalcaemia) ho to tetany.
Taalluq: haddi jism ka calcium store bhi hai; osteocytes aur osteoclasts zaroorat par calcium blood mein chhorte hain, taake muscles aur nerves ko musalsal mile.

blocks.prompt:
2. Why is the human skeleton designed with both rigid bones and flexible joints instead of being made of a single solid structure?
Insaani skeleton aik thos dhanche ke bajaye sakht haddiyon aur lachakdar joints se kyun bana hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Sakht haddiyan sahara, shakal aur hifazat deti hain (khopri dimagh ki, rib cage dil aur phephron ki) aur levers ka kaam karti hain.
2. In ke darmiyan joints fulcrum hain, is liye muscles hisson ko kai taraf hila sakte hain: ball-and-socket (kandha, kulha), hinge (kohni, ghutna), pivot, saddle, gliding. Aik thos dhancha hil hi nahi sakta.
3. Joints ki cartilage aur discs jhatke jazb karte aur ragar kam karte hain, haddiyon aur dimagh ko jhatkon se bachate hain.
4. Alag alag haddiyan siron se barh sakti hain aur aik hissa toote to sirf wahi theek hota hai; lachakdar joints saans (pasliyon ki harkat) aur do pairon par seedha khara hone (S-shaped reedh, paon ki mehraab) mein bhi madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Why do muscles always work in pairs (antagonistic muscles) rather than alone?
Muscles hamesha jore (antagonistic) mein kyun kaam karte hain, akele kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation:
1. Muscle sirf kheench (contract) sakta hai; khud ko wapas lamba nahi dhakel sakta.
2. Is liye aik muscle haddi ko sirf aik taraf hila sakta hai. Wapas lane ke liye doosri taraf doosra muscle ulta kheenchta hai.
3. Har jore mein flexor contract (jor morna) ho to extensor dheela, aur extensor contract (seedha karna) ho to flexor dheela: maslan kohni par biceps aur triceps, ghutne par hamstrings aur quadriceps.
4. Jore mein kaam karne se harkat narm aur qaboo mein rehti hai aur jor jama rehta hai (posture).

blocks.prompt:
4. Why does prolonged inactivity or space travel lead to muscle atrophy and bone weakening??
Lambi be-harkati ya khala ka safar muscles ke sukarne (atrophy) aur haddiyon ki kamzori ka sabab kyun banta hai?
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se bahar, magar usi par mabni.)
1. Haddiyan aur muscles zinda tissues hain jo un par parne wale bojh ke mutabiq dhalte hain. Wazan uthane wali warzish ki kami haddiyan kamzor karti hai (chapter ise osteoporosis ki wajah likhta hai).
2. Bistar par lambe aaram ya khala ki be-wazni mein haddiyan jism ka bojh nahi uthatin aur muscles gravity ke khilaf kaam nahi karte. Tab osteoclasts haddi ko osteoblasts ke banane se tez torte hain; calcium blood aur peshab mein nikal jata hai aur haddi ki density kam ho jati hai.
3. Istemal na hone wale muscle fibres apne proteins (actin aur myosin) kho kar patle aur kamzor ho jate hain: muscle atrophy, khaas tor par taangon aur kamar ke muscles jo posture sambhalte hain.
4. Bachao: baqaida warzish; maslan astronauts khala mein treadmill aur resistance machines chalate hain, mareez physiotherapy karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal ke aakhir mein do sawaliya nishan ("??") chhape hain; sahi aik hai.
